items.heading: Start with Business Pain
items.text: Start with business pain. Ask which second skill helps your current base solve a more valuable problem.

items.heading: Stay Adjacent First
items.text: Stay adjacent first. The best second skill is often close enough to your current work that you can build proof quickly.

items.heading: Check Proof
items.text: Check proof-of-work potential. If you cannot show the combined value in a portfolio, project, or measurable result, the stack may stay invisible.
